Reviewed subject: docs/proposals/2026-09-09-simplify-required-validation-and-design-retention.md at sha256:cfebb8caf0073b7bed66e433ffae2edad663d640d05c6baadd969a905045fc61.

The user supplied the second proposal; the parent agent copied it unchanged and authored the preceding consolidation proposal. Independent reviewer independent-validation-proposal-review authored neither proposal and made no changes to them. The reviewer read the complete second proposal and complete preceding direction, examined the triggered current authority, and owns this assessment. This is actual contributor separation, not a new role label for an author.

## Review Dimensions

| Dimension | Judgment | Basis |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Challenge | pass | Distinguishes fragmented authority from the new substantive problem: inherited mandatory execution and automatic source retention may themselves be unnecessary. Existing check groups alone do not establish necessity. |
| Goals | pass | Necessary validation, understandable language and necessary current Design content are explicit outcomes; there is no numerical savings or deletion quota. |
| Scope | pass | Validation policy and retention form the selected core; System and real consumers are bounded dependencies. Other models and skill improvements remain separately owned. Unknown inseparable dependencies return for a decision. |
| Governing principle | pass | A concise engineering principle distinguishes the obligation from its historical check or document and justifies mandatory fresh execution by purpose and evidence. |
| Direction | pass | Required/advisory status, applicability, execution frequency, equivalent protection, deliberate obligation retirement and source retention are separately assessable decisions. Runtime safeguards and semantic assessment retain their owners. |
| Feasibility | pass | The single embedded assessment cites established check families and adjacent owners, discloses unknown cost/dependencies/removals, and identifies a bounded minimum Design package. No savings or safe individual deletion is claimed. |
| Material impact | pass | Regression risk from narrowed execution and reduced convenient access to old reasoning are disclosed, together with conservative uncertainty handling and preservation of necessary current rationale and reliance evidence. |
| Vision alignment | pass | Current obligations, meaningful decisions, open findings and evidence remain understandable from checked-in authoritative artifacts. Optional version history is not required to reconstruct current rules. Removing unnecessary duplication therefore does not defeat VISION's traceability or resumability commitments. |
| Downstream authority | pass | Exact source/check selection, mandatory conditions, retention amendments, interfaces, compatibility and proof allocation remain with Design and Delivery. The proposal expressly does not waive a currently applicable failure or authorize individual removals. |
| Requested decision | pass | Explicitly revises the preceding preserve-policy/preserve-original defaults within Validation, preserves separate safety and assessment boundaries, and requests direction approval only. |

## Scope Preservation Review

- Scope-preservation result: pass.

The supplied second direction preserves the latest user intent to reconsider mandatory validation, applicability, fresh runs and necessary-design retention. It does not incorrectly inherit the preceding proposal's preserve-existing-policy and readable-original defaults. Plain terminology, System's completed Skill correction, bounded consumer reconciliation and explicit separate ownership remain visible. The scope table's treatment prose clearly identifies core work, necessary dependencies and excluded later transfers; exact standard labels are unnecessary where the classification is unambiguous. Existing FU-013–018 retain named receiving ownership for excluded responsibilities and skills; FU-012 identifies the selected validation responsibility. No new backlog or per-test ledger is demanded.

## Recommended Proposal Edits

- Recommended edits: none required.

## Recommendation

- Recommendation: approve the revised direction and stop after recording this isolated review.

The policy change is deliberate and disclosed rather than a silent conflict. Current retention or check mandates remain effective until exact owning amendments are reviewed and adopted; the proposal explicitly selects those amendments as downstream work. Historical approvals must keep their original meaning, while current reliance on removed subjects must end or retain its necessary basis. This is compatible with preserving meaningful current evidence and does not authorize rewriting historical records.

TEST-SR-07–10 already distinguish protection from age, cost or missing labels and require justified retirement or adequate retained proof. RC-SR-15 already permits affirmative evidence reuse while preserving freshness overrides; the proposed redesign preserves that assessment owner and real-operation safeguards. The published-skill-first contract R14/R17–22/R25 contains existing ledger, retirement, measurement and selection obligations that Design must explicitly disposition where the new direction changes them. These are selected downstream amendments, not grounds for denying a proposal merely because it proposes change.

Evidence inspected: full second proposal and preceding consolidation proposal; CONSTITUTION.md; VISION.md; System responsibility inventory; Design DES-SR-06/13/14/18/19; Test requirements TEST-SR-01–13; Review and Closeout RC-SR-01–18; published-skill-first-repository-simplification R1–29; FU-012–018; and the completed Skill initiative's successful Verify report as historical adoption evidence supporting the bounded System correction. This assessment does not renew that earlier Verify or certify all of its current dependencies. The current System row still uses prospective language, substantiating the proposed correction without repeating the pilot.

No-map rationale: the decision relies on the directly inspected named responsibility owners and follow-up boundaries; it makes no current implementation dependency-graph claim. No runtime or cost inspection was necessary because the proposal explicitly leaves actual selection behavior, individual safe removals and savings unknown. Required proposal-review assessment, reliance, conditional gates, recording guidance and result asset were read. Read-only cat, sed, rg and primary context/subject inspect commands established the assessment basis; no behavior or package test pass is claimed.
